Example hand drawings of imagined pain (palmar view)

Source: R/data.R
pdr_example_palmar.Rd

A small, deliberately silly data set collected to demonstrate the PainDraw and paindrawr workflows. Participants first chose between a hammer and an apple, and then a distance (10 cm or 1 m). They were then told that the chosen object had fallen from that height and landed on their left hand, and were asked to draw their imaginary hand pain on a palmar lower arm template.

Usage

pdr_example_palmar

Format

A tibble with 30 rows and 4 columns:

id

Integer. Participant (record) identifier.

palmar

List column with one drawing per row (NULL if missing).

tool

Factor. Object that fell on the hand: "Apple" or "Hammer".

distance

Factor. Height the object fell from: "10 centimeters" or "1 meter".

Source

Collected by the package authors; created in data-raw/pdr_example_palmar.R.

Details

One participant (id 22) has a missing drawing (and missing tool and distance). The drawing is NULL, which is useful for demonstrating how missing drawings are handled as opposed to empty drawings. File paths and timestamps have been removed from the drawings. Use pdr_add_rgba() to rasterise the drawings. The matching background image is bg_lower_arm_palmar.png in system.file("extdata", package = "paindrawr").
